articles.headline: Dollar firms as Fed signals hawkish stance on rates

articles.headline: Gold rallies as Treasury yields fall on soft CPI
articles.snippet: Gold prices climbed as falling Treasury yields and a softer CPI print boosted demand for the metal.

articles.headline: Euro slips vs pound after ECB holds rates steady

articles.headline: Aussie gains on strong employment data
